prompt: Two TextEdit windows are open, titled "{window}" and "{window2}". Record both of them together in one take for 4 seconds into the Splice project {project}, so the video shows the two windows side by side as they sit on screen. Use the splice MCP tools only.

checks.name: one take with a second window layer
checks.expr: len(takes) == 1 and len(take_clips()) == 1 and any(i['kind'] == 'media' for i in items)

checks.name: both windows on screen together
checks.expr: all(i['length'] >= 0.8 * take_clips()[0]['length'] for i in items if i['kind'] == 'media')
